The protected wrapping step of a Wrapper subclass gives way to the inherited `fromHandle`, typed on the class it is called on and returning `undefined` for an undefined Handle, while a creation member returns `this.expect(Native(...), detail)` instead.
No constructor asks whether it is wrapping an existing Handle any more: the protected constructor takes the Handle and only stores it, and the base registers the Wrapper.
